finding: One archive step took 231.7 ms at 16x: the first chunk read through the run of other op_events between the template's own status rows and the status window. The step bounded the status rows it returns, not the rows it reads.
fix: Each call reads at most a window of 20,000 ids; a window without status rows is remembered as scanned; a chunk is also complete when its window ends before the cutoff or its day is before the cutoff's day.
